artworks.label: Stellar Spire
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for stellar-cradle. A magnificent single star-forming nebula pillar, a tapering craglike tower of translucent interstellar dust with branching wisps along its sides, illuminated from within by a newborn tiny white-gold star near its summit. Fiery copper-orange gas on its left edge and electric cobalt-blue vapor on its right, against true empty transparent space. Fine astrophotographic filaments, physically textured smoky depth, exquisite luminosity, dark navy shadowed core. Vertical compact nebula silhouette with a few tiny attached spark-like stars; a gas pillar rather than an egg, galaxy, disk or bipolar jet. Match a dramatic realistic orange-and-blue stellar-nursery collection. Whole subject centered, compact readable silhouette, generous18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Entirely new art, never copy/crop/recolour an existing image.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
